links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and completeness of chatbot CAPD answers by question difficulty
links.effect: Mean accuracy below 4.0 and completeness about 3.5; complex questions often scored below 3.0; only 3 of 44 questions consistently rated >=4 across all three chatbots.
links.quote: Current AI chatbots provided generally accurate CAPD information but fell short of clinical standards, particularly on specialized questions.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots responding to central auditory processing disorder queries evaluated by clinical experts, testing baseline accuracy and completeness without comparing deployment guardrails or practices.
